explain: Two series are interleaved. Odd positions go −3, −1, 1 (+2) and even positions go −8, −6, −4 (+2). The next is an odd position: 3.
The denominators interleave: 8, 12, 16 (+4) and 14, 21, 28 (+7). The next is an odd position: 1/20.
Each denominator is the sum of the two before it: 3+8=11, 8+11=19, 11+19=30, 19+30=49. Next: 30 + 49 = 79.
The differences are −19, −16, −13, −10, shrinking by 3 each time. The next difference is −7, so 70 − 7 = 63.
Each term is the previous × 3 + 1: 121 × 3 + 1 = 364.
